product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Velvet Texture Striated Decorative Throw Pillow, 17" x 17", Honeycomb
product.description: A classic look with modern updates, this luxurious velvet pillow has subtle striations running throughout. The deep yellow color freshens up your décor, while the understated pattern allows for easy mixing and matching with other pillows. Soft velvet texture and subtle pattern for modern and classic touches Sewn in U.S. of durable polyester fabric Pillow Cover: 100% Polyester. Insert Shell: 100% Cotton. Stuffing: 100% Polyester Made in USA and Imported Removable plush fiber-filled insert included Pillow cover features hidden bottom zipper 17" x 17" Spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
